description: Savor the vibrant flavors of the Middle East with this homemade vegetarian falafel plate, a delightful assembly of crispy falafel, fresh salads, and tangy pickles. Each bite offers a harmonious blend of textures and tastes, making it a truly satisfying and wholesome meal. Drizzled with creamy tahini sauce, this plate brings authentic Levantine culinary joy right to your table.

instructions.title: Soak Chickpeas
instructions.text: Begin by soaking the dried chickpeas in a large bowl of cold water overnight, or for at least 12 hours. Ensure they are fully submerged, as they will expand. Drain and rinse thoroughly before use.

instructions.title: Prepare Falafel Mixture
instructions.text: In a food processor, combine the soaked and drained chickpeas, roughly chopped onion, garlic cloves, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, ground coriander, baking soda, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Pulse until the mixture is finely chopped but not pureed, resembling coarse sand. Do not over-process; it should still have some texture. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and cover.

instructions.title: Chill and Form Falafel
instructions.text: Refrigerate the falafel mixture for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the mixture to firm up, making it easier to handle. Once chilled, use a falafel scoop or your hands to form small, flat patties or balls, about 1.5 inches in diameter. Press them firmly to prevent crumbling during frying.

instructions.title: Fry Falafel to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pot or Dutch oven to 350-375F (175-190C). Carefully drop a few falafel into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for 3-5 minutes per batch, turning occasionally, until they are deep golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a wire rack lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.

instructions.title: Whip Up the Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: While the falafel fries, prepare the tahini sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini paste, freshly squeezed lemon juice, minced garlic clove, and a pinch of salt. Gradually add cold water, a tablespoon at a time, whisking continuously until the sauce reaches a smooth, creamy, and pourable consistency. It should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.

instructions.title: Assemble Your Vegetarian Falafel Plate
instructions.text: Arrange the crispy falafel on a platter alongside warm pita bread, diced tomatoes, diced cucumbers, sliced pickled turnips or cucumbers, and shredded fresh lettuce. Generously drizzle the creamy tahini sauce over the falafel and vegetables. Serve immediately and enjoy the authentic taste of the Middle East.

tips: For truly authentic falafel, use a traditional falafel scoop to create uniform shapes and ensure even cooking.
Do not use canned chickpeas for falafel; dried chickpeas soaked overnight are essential for the correct texture and flavor.
Falafel is best served immediately when hot and crispy. If making ahead, store the mixture in the fridge and fry just before serving.
article:
Dive into the heart of Middle Eastern flavors right from your kitchen! The Vegetarian Falafel Plate is more than just a meal; it's a vibrant, wholesome culinary experience that delights the senses and nourishes the soul. Featuring golden-crisp falafel, creamy tahini sauce, refreshing salads, and warm pita bread, this iconic dish is a testament to the deliciousness of plant-based eating. Whether you're a seasoned vegetarian, looking to incorporate more meat-free meals into your diet, or simply a food adventurer, mastering the Vegetarian Falafel Plate Recipe will open up a world of authentic flavors. Get ready to transform simple ingredients into an extraordinary feast that’s surprisingly easy to make and incredibly satisfying.

## What is a Vegetarian Falafel Plate?
At its core, a Vegetarian Falafel Plate is a vibrant, wholesome culinary experience, emblematic of Middle Eastern cuisine. The star, falafel, consists of savory, deep-fried patties or balls made from ground chickpeas (sometimes fava beans), fresh herbs like parsley and cilantro, and aromatic spices such as cumin and coriander. These golden-brown morsels are crispy on the outside and tender, fluffy on the inside. A complete falafel plate features falafel alongside creamy hummus, tangy tahini sauce, a fresh chopped salad (typically cucumbers, tomatoes, and parsley), and an assortment of pickled vegetables, traditionally served with warm, fluffy pita bread. Naturally vegan, packed with protein and fiber, it’s a satisfying, healthy, and complete meal option for any time of day.

## Ingredients You Need
To make your perfect Vegetarian Falafel Plate Recipe, freshness is paramount, especially for the herbs, which lend the falafel its distinctive green hue and aromatic taste.

For the Falafel:
*   1 lb (approx. 2 cups) dried chickpeas, soaked in cold water overnight (do NOT use canned chickpeas)
*   1 medium yellow onion, roughly chopped
*   6-8 cloves garlic, peeled
*   1 cup fresh parsley, roughly chopped
*   1 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped
*   1 teaspoon ground cumin
*   1 teaspoon ground coriander
*   1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional, for a kick)
*   1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
*   1/2 teaspoon black pepper, or to taste
*   1/2 teaspoon baking soda
*   2-3 tablespoons all-purpose flour (or chickpea flour for gluten-free), as a binder
*   Vegetable oil or canola oil, for deep frying

For the Creamy Tahini Sauce:
*   1/2 cup tahini paste (sesame paste)
*   1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
*   1 small clove garlic, minced (or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder)
*   1/4 teaspoon salt
*   1/4 - 1/2 cup cold water (to achieve desired consistency)

For the Fresh Salad:
*   2-3 Roma tomatoes, finely diced
*   1 large cucumber, finely diced
*   1/4 red onion, finely diced (optional)
*   1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
*   1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
*   1 tablespoon olive oil
*   Salt and pepper to taste
